title: AutoNEAR · what does NEAR need? (v3, constellation)

voice.name: Puck
voice.style: Confident, warm product-launch narration at a brisk pace of about three words per second, with crisp sentences and short natural pauses. Curious and close at the start, gaining energy through the constellation and the swarm, then calm and exact at the limits and the close.

tokens_note: Numbers only as {{tokens}} resolved from src/data/captured.json (and contracts.json). No typed digits in narration.

scenes.narration: We all want NEAR to grow. But which way? What does the network need right now, and how would we know?
scenes.style: Quiet, curious and close to the microphone; let the second question hang.

scenes.narration: The crowd already knows. It says so in public, every day. But studying it by hand takes months, even a year.
scenes.style: Warm and plain; a tired, dry tone on the last sentence.

scenes.narration: Meet AutoNEAR. It reads those signals nonstop, ranks what NEAR needs, and builds toward it. The owner keeps a hand on the brake.
scenes.style: Lift into the product name, proud but not shouted; slow down on the brake line.

scenes.narration: {{prod.sourcesOk|W}} sources, all live. {{prod.feeds|w}} feeds. {{prod.evidence|w}} posts and commits read, each linked to where it came from.
scenes.style: Steady and bright, like pointing at something real.

scenes.narration: Seven seats vote on every idea, and one of them is a skeptic. Today {{prod.winner.word}} clears the bar and gets a go. The vote repeats as new evidence arrives.
scenes.style: Tighter and quicker, like seven people voting; drop low on say no.

scenes.narration: Then a swarm takes over. Five cursors race through its product page. Copy. Layout. Style. Media. Check.
scenes.style: Fast and playful; each of the five words lands like a tap.

scenes.narration: The builder picks up a contract build that is compiled, tested and fingerprinted. {{suites.nearContract.passed|w}} tests pass. The agent can deploy only code the owner approved by that fingerprint.
scenes.style: Precise and calm; slow slightly on only code the owner approved.

scenes.tag: PUBLIC TESTNET · DEMO OWNER KEY · AUTOMATED
scenes.narration: Within limits the owner sets, the agent works on its own. It draws its own gas and deploys approved code. The chain holds the line: {{testnet.refusalCount|w}} times on NEAR testnet, it said no.
scenes.style: Confident with an edge; low and exact on the chain says no.

scenes.tag: RECORDED RUN · FIXTURE INPUTS · MOCKED RPC
scenes.narration: The owner decides, and can stop it at any time. A wrong fingerprint is refused. That is the brake.
scenes.style: Measured and human; the last sentence flat and final.

scenes.narration: Next, the community tests every build and confirms it before it goes live. AutoNEAR: public demand in, a product on the table, a human on the brake. Judges: clone it, run the tests.
scenes.style: Slow down for the finish; warm on the last line; light, direct call to action.
